messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity of the physical pendulum and the moment of inertia about the pivot. Pivot friction in the physical pendulum model should be taken into account when the pendulum is suspended at a point other than the center of mass. Mass distribution affects the damping behavior, and the viscous friction force becomes significant when the pivot is not perfectly smooth. Smooth pivot behavior means the viscous friction force can be neglected in the physical pendulum model.
